markets.name: Brunswick Winter Market
markets.about: We created the first winter market in Maine and are located in Fort Andross, an old mill along the Androscoggin River. Our vendors live in Maine and represent their own business. We are farmers, bakers, product producers, craftspersons enthusiastically supported by the community.
